[Case Study] Ian Taylor Trekking The adventure-seeking clients of U.S.-based Ian Taylor Trekking come to the award-winning travel operator in search of challenging climbing itineraries across the globe. Paying for those trips shouldn’t be part of those challenges. ‌
The award-winning travel operator looked to Flywire to make it easy for its global clientele to pay online and in local currency, saving their customers hundreds of dollars on transfer fees and easing collection and reconciliation for the operator. ‌
